Ordinary path: Space becomes usable; occupant takes possession; equipment is serviced; defects repaired; space returned
Typical break: Access denied; diagnosis wrong; part absent; contractor unavailable; work marked complete prematurely
Product implication: Digital progress must correspond to a real change in the property

Ordinary path: Occupant/subsidy pays; bank settles; ledger allocates; operating bills and debt paid; required reserves retained; owner receives available cash; manager earns agreed fees
Typical break: Returned payment; wrong owner ledger; restricted cash mistaken for spendable cash; duplicate invoice; unapproved cost
Product implication: The account with cash is not necessarily the party entitled to spend it

Ordinary path: Law and contracts establish rights; owner/board delegates; PM approves; qualified parties execute; regulator/court may supersede
Typical break: Owner absent; unclear scope; unsigned amendment; expired power; court hold; contradictory instruction
Product implication: Action rights need actual scope, limit, effective date, and change handling

Ordinary path: A report enters; facts are checked; a decision made; someone commits; updates and completion return
Typical break: Multiple inboxes; stale status; silent waiting; disputed facts; undocumented promise
Product implication: Track who will do what by when and whether the promised result happened
